conditions.fixture: Eligible fixture from893e6395, N2048 terrain seed99,2048 neurons,32768 synapses,17 routes,4 microsteps,25 candidates/tick,64 initial dendrites/128 inputs,nonzero periodic inputs/offsets,no structural edges in timing/memory assays; synthetic, not an acquired trajectory
conditions.checked_profile: test profile;alife_training opt-level3;default debug assertions/overflow checks enabled; core/world/backend/runtime opt-level2
conditions.release_like_profile: same test build with only alife_training debug-assertions=false and overflow-checks=false;opt-level3;not an actual release application or GPU build
conditions.timing: two warmups and11 trials/mode/shape, alternating reverse order; full output word equality outside every timed span; destruction outside clock
conditions.component_scope: exclusive spans in a test-only instrumented copy of the exact original packer. Controls measure original actual production and frozen reference before change. Instrumentation/codegen can change timing; component medians must not be added to separately measured uninstrumented totals. Allocation-call timing excludes lazy page zeroing charged to later writes.
conditions.same_binary_comparison: actual production candidate versus exact frozen original body. Before-change controls quantify codegen/context differences of frozen reference versus actual production; separate-build before/after is not a matched speedup.
conditions.prefix_scope: fresh sequence validation + packet packing + fresh headers; overlaps pack-only; excludes layout construction, output destruction, queue writes/staging, resource allocation, encoding,device waits,neural forward/backward and Adam
conditions.memory: two fresh processes/mode/shape/profile, output held for sampling. Rust GlobalAlloc counts packer requests only; OS status/smaps include fixture/executable/metadata/harness. Before, packet-held and after-drop RSS and reported process VmHWM recorded. Neither allocator requests nor sampled/high-water RSS are a strict deployed Windows peak/admission bound.
conditions.instrumentation: counters disabled for timing, but pass-through allocator TLS check remains in candidate binary. No pure unwrapped-System overhead control; same allocator wrapper for both compared packers.
conditions.warm_state: fixtures/layout and warm metadata prepared outside clocks; outputs verified after timing; uncontrolled allocator/page history and VM scheduling
conditions.hardware: AMD EPYC9V74 VM;5 visible vCPUs;4-CPU quota;16GiB memory;unpinned CPUs0-4
conditions.uncertainty: descriptive medians/min/max only; no formal confidence interval;11 sequential timing trials and2 memory processes/mode. Compiler context effects visible in baseline controls. No GPU/end-to-end gain or competence claim.

validation.matrix: 324 complete-word comparisons across N512/N1024/N2048,two grounded profiles,three lengths/burns,three dendrite topologies,1/25/32 candidates,empty/nonempty structural context
validation.float_bits: 12 patterns at first/middle/last offsets across three ticks; signed zero,subnormals,finite extremes,infinities and positive/negative/signaling NaN payloads; direct private serialization equality; public validation still rejects nonfinite inputs
validation.invalid_inputs: 14 invalid cases rejected before invoking either packer in the validation wrapper; production validation call ordering unchanged
validation.focused: 3 passed in each profile;3 explicit manual assays ignored by default
validation.manual: 3 passed in each profile,including8 fresh memory children per profile and equal complete packet SHA256 across modes/profiles
validation.clippy: cargo clippy --locked -p alife_training --features cpu-backend --lib --tests -- -D warnings passed
validation.ci_selector: Exact new CI selector in default test profile:3 passed,1 ignored,113 filtered out
validation.workflow_yaml: Parsed successfully; existing native-cpu job includes the new regression selector
